info.title: decisio
info.description: The HTTP API of a decisio server: TypeSafe's System One wire on `POST /v1/systemone`, with routes for tasks, abstention, health and metrics. Generated from the server's code; `docs/api.md` is the prose.

post.summary: The engine's own route (conformance gates and benchmarks)

get.summary: The served model, in System One's format

post.summary: TypeSafe's System One wire: answer typed questions about a state

200.description: The answers, by the request's question names.

x-decisio-server-ms.description: The server's time for the request, in milliseconds.

x-decisio-route.description: The route that served it: `text` or `image`.

x-decisio-tasks.description: The registered tasks applied, when any were.

x-decisio-adapter.description: The adapter that answered, when one did.

x-decisio-think-ms.description: The milliseconds spent on reasoning and the second reads, when thinking was on for the request.

x-decisio-think-tokens.description: The reasoning tokens generated, when thinking was on for the request.

x-decisio-state-truncated.description: `kept=N; of=M; part=start`, when the state was cut (`over_limit`).

x-decisio-stages.description: Where the engine's time went, e.g. `prepare=1.2;warm=0.0;questions=52.1;readout=0.1;engine=53.6`.

x-decisio-wait-behind.description: `registration` when a boundary registration was running when the request arrived.

400.description: An unusable asset (`api_usage_error`) or a request the engine cannot answer (`detail` string).

404.description: An adapter that is not loaded.

415.description: A POST that is not JSON (or a multipart request without `x-decisio-client`).

422.description: A request that does not validate (for example a choice with more than 255 options).

500.description: The model's arithmetic produced a non-finite probability (not the request's fault).

503.description: The engine has died; the server is exiting.

post.description: A state and typed questions (`noul`, `choice`, `score`), answered with probabilities and System One's confidence. Images go in `assets` (placeholders in the texts), in `images` (imajev), as `data:image` URIs in the state, or in a multipart request; they are served by the image engine (a server started with `--image-model`).

parameters.name: x-decisio-route
parameters.description: Choose the route explicitly; `image` sends a text request to the image engine (the paired check).

parameters.name: x-decisio-debug
parameters.description: Add the raw readout to the response; only on a server started with `--debug-readout` (verification, never production).

parameters.name: x-decisio-client
parameters.description: Required, with any value, on a `multipart/form-data` request (a request a browser can send without a preflight is refused with 415).

additionalProperties.description: An image part named by the `part` of an asset (System One's encoding).

post.summary: Register an abstention threshold from labelled examples
Register a recurring question from labelled examples (calibration, intent head, certificate)

200.description: The task's record: what was fitted, what is applied, the certificate.

get.summary: List the registered tasks (`full=1` for the form `/v1/tasks/import` takes)
get.description:
Every registered task; `?full=1` includes the heads' arrays, the form `--tasks-file` loads. A certified task
also carries its `status` (ok, traffic_changed or suspended).
One task, with its status and the answer-mix monitor's facts when it is certified.

post.summary: Make a task's certificate again under the current serving stack

get.description: Per certified task, in Prometheus text format: state, answers, certified answers, answer-mix distance.

post.description:
Load tasks as `GET /v1/tasks?full=1` returns them (no re-scoring); refused when fitted under another model or
rendering (re-register those from their examples).

Asset.description:
System One's image asset: an image that replaces its placeholder, with its bytes in `data_base64` (and their
`format`), or, in a multipart request, the name of the image part that holds them.
Asset.title: Asset

certified.description: Present when a registered certified task applies: whether this answer carries the promise.
certified.title: Certified

unknown_probability.description: imajev's extension (its encodings only): the probability of an unknown outcome.
unknown_probability.title: Unknown Probability

abstained.description: imajev's extension, and abstention tasks: whether the server abstained.
abstained.title: Abstained

choice.description: The most probable option's key; among tied options the key that sorts first.
choice.title: Choice

confidence.description: System One's: the top probability rescaled from uniform.
confidence.title: Confidence

probabilities.description: The distribution over the options, by key.
probabilities.title: Probabilities

certified.title: Certified

unknown_probability.title: Unknown Probability

abstained.title: Abstained

certified.title: Certified

unknown_probability.title: Unknown Probability

abstained.title: Abstained

confidence.description: System One's: the concentration at the mode.
confidence.title: Confidence

legend.description: Each level's index and description, as the request wrote it.
legend.title: Legend

probabilities.description: The distribution over the levels, by index.
probabilities.title: Probabilities

input_tokens.description: The state and each question's own text in the served tokenizer, plus the image tokens.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

output_tokens.description: One per question, plus the reasoning tokens of the questions that thought (`thinking_tokens`).
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

thinking_tokens.description: The reasoning tokens generated for the request; present when thinking was on for it.
thinking_tokens.title: Thinking Tokens

model.description: The model name the request sent, or the served model's name when it sent none.
model.title: Model

adapter.description: The adapter that answered, when the request named one.
adapter.title: Adapter

thinking.description: When thinking was on for the request (`think`): `questions` that thought, `of`, `tokens`, `ms`, the `factor` and `budget`, and per question `thought` with its `tokens`, or why it did not.
thinking.title: Thinking

state_truncated.description: When the state was cut (`over_limit: truncate`): `kept_tokens`, `of_tokens`, `part` (`start`) and `limit`. No answer of a truncated state is certified.
state_truncated.title: State Truncated

engine.description: The engine's facts (vLLM version, GPU, mode, padding, quantization); the string `dead` once it has died.
engine.title: Engine

base.description: The base, the checkpoint and its revision, `engine_process`, the temperatures and the prompt.
base.title: Base

systemone.description: The System One route's settings: rendering, `noul_commit`, abstention, `orders`, tasks, temperatures.
systemone.title: Systemone

image_engine.description: The image engine's facts (including `max_images`), when `--image-model` is set.
image_engine.title: Image Engine

request.description: A /v1/systemone request with exactly one question (text only for POST /v1/tasks).

answer.description: The option key; null for an unanswerable example (abstention tasks).
answer.title: Answer

alpha.description: At most this share of the certified answers is wrong.
alpha.title: Alpha

delta.description: The promise fails with at most this probability.
delta.title: Delta

min_examples.description: Fewest held-out examples to accept; never fewer than alpha and delta need (59 at the defaults).
min_examples.title: Min Examples

holdout.description: The share of the task's examples held out when `examples` is not given.
holdout.title: Holdout

suspend_on_alert.description: Stop certifying while the traffic monitor's confidence alert is on.
suspend_on_alert.title: Suspend On Alert

examples.description: Labelled like the task's own; never fitted on.
examples.title: Examples

option.description: `{"key": "<the request's own abstain key>"}` or `{"append": "<text of an option the server adds>"}`.
option.title: Option
